policy.decision_unit: resolved Mathlib/Lake graph plus cache protocol/payload/helper, Anneal materialization/restoration/pruning, and semantic consumer evidence

gates.question: Are exact Mathlib and inherited package revisions recorded?
checks: Resolve Aeneas and Lean identities.
Record Mathlib commit, inputRev, and complete lake-manifest closure.
Diff all changed package revisions.
reject_if: Only a tag/version label is recorded.
Manifest changes are unreviewed.

gates.question: Does the proposed Mathlib state match the exact Lean/Lake toolchain?
checks: Compare Mathlib and Aeneas lean-toolchain files.
Verify Anneal packages that exact Lean release.
Apply Lean/Lake upgrade gates if the toolchain changes.
reject_if: Prepared artifacts come from a different Lean build without explicit compatibility evidence.

gates.question: Does the Mathlib cache command still have the transport/install behavior Anneal uses?
checks: Diff Cache/Main.lean and Cache/Requests.lean.
Verify get- still means download without decompression.
Record endpoint, local-cache, partial-file, retry, and override semantics.
reject_if: Anneal command semantics changed without migration.
Network materialization now mutates the final build tree unexpectedly.

gates.question: Is the custom module cache-key contract understood and appropriately invalidated?
checks: Diff root/module hashing code.
Record all root/key inputs.
Verify changed project/config inputs cause reviewed key changes.
Keep filename key separate from Lake depHash.
reject_if: Archive names are compared without revalidating their key algorithm/inputs.
Filename hash and archive-header hash are conflated.

gates.question: Are cache payload membership and archive/helper semantics compatible?
checks: Diff required/optional build paths in Cache/IO.lean.
Resolve exact leantar/helper implementation.
Inventory at least one representative archive.
Probe old/new format compatibility if helper/format changes.
reject_if: New required artifact families are silently dropped.
Format/helper changes are inferred compatible from .ltar suffix alone.

gates.question: Are native and host-specific outputs preserved on every supported host?
checks: Inventory native/object/shared/plugin/executable products.
Run representative restore/build on each supported host class.
Record architecture/ABI-specific differences.
reject_if: Portability is inferred from one host or from pure .olean presence only.

gates.question: Has Anneal reviewed and re-pinned the actual network materialization output?
checks: Run production-equivalent fixed-output materialization per supported host.
Inspect tree diffs before updating recursive hashes.
Keep network phase separate from ordinary transforms.
reject_if: Expected hashes are changed without reviewing resulting tree.
Fixed-output identity is treated as semantic/provenance proof.

gates.question: Does restored state work in Anneal final consumer topology?
checks: Move to fresh consumer location.
Make intended shared state read-only.
Deny/observe network access.
Record unexpected writes/fetches/rebuilds.
reject_if: Only producer-location success is tested.
Hidden network or shared-tree writes are tolerated.

gates.question: Is Anneal pruning still complete and conservative for the new graph/layout?
checks: Recompute source/trace closure.
Diff retained/deleted modules.
Review changed source/module/native-artifact layout.
Validate final pruned tree through production consumer.
reject_if: Required modules/artifacts are removed.
Source reachability is used to justify deleting unrelated package/native metadata.

gates.question: Is cache-seeded behavior semantically equivalent to a clean build for representative consumers?
checks: Compare representative elaboration/proof behavior.
Compare required Lean/native artifacts or justify differences.
Inspect trace/setup/import state and rebuild/reuse observations.
Classify intentional path-bearing differences.
reject_if: Acceptance rests only on file presence or exit status.
Unexpected semantic/proof differences remain unexplained.

gates.question: Does the full production cache lifecycle work from identity resolution through final proof use?
checks: Exercise download-only materialization, restore, rewrite, prune, relocate, read-only/offline consumption, and representative proof/build.
Preserve commands, revisions, manifests, hashes, host identity, inventories, and outcomes.
reject_if: Any component uses an identity or artifact not represented in the evidence package.
The final consumer requires an unplanned network access, rebuild, write, or different toolchain.
